summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Taner Kızıltoprak as CFO, effective July 1, 2026, replacing Boris Dolgushin, who will serve as an advisor. The change is orderly with a transition period. No financial terms or shareholder vote required. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, but the CFO departure is itself a management event. As a non-U.S. issuer, the 6-K is equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K for material events. The outgoing CFO led the company through its Nasdaq listing and acquisitions. Watch for any additional strategic shifts under new CFO.
